acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The change is a single commit touching only smoke/pnd34-1.md.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: jj/git diff of the PR against main.

steps: Create smoke/pnd34-1.md containing exactly 'kind smoke pnd34 1 2026-09-17T22:11:22Z' with one trailing newline.
Verify content and single-file diff (AC1, AC2) locally.
Split the file into its own commit, set bookmark legion/SPND34-1, push, open PR with body line 'Dispatch: SPND34-1'.
Record E2E (implementer) proof (AC1/AC2 output + head SHA + negative control) in .legion/implement.json and PR body.

Confirm CI 'check' conclusion 'success' at head SHA (AC3).
Add E2E (tester) line with re-run output and one negative control (wrong-string comparison).

implement: legion-worker — governs the shared jj workspace, single-commit split, bookmark/push, PR body, and the E2E proof gate for this one-file doc change; no code-domain skill applies.
test: legion-worker — defines the tester's duty to verify the implementer's proof and add an independent E2E line; the byte-exact line check plus green CI is the whole verification for a one-line doc.
review: legion-worker — sets docs-only review discipline (skip Thermo, individual thread disposition, approve only the .legion/-free head) for this sandbox change.

risks: Byte-exactness: a stray trailing space, CRLF, or altered timestamp fails AC1 — write exactly and prove with the equality check.
Accidental extra changes would break single-commit/single-file — confirm --summary shows only smoke/pnd34-1.md.
